tools.name: split_beams_by_columns
tools.description: Split structural beams at columns (pyRevit: Cutbeambycolumn). Recreates location-curve segments; not a solid cut. Straight and curved beams (curves are tessellated) and cuts at the real column footprint. Copies instance parameters (Mark, Comments, offsets) onto new pieces. Params: beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; columns fall back to all in model), dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean (suffix new Marks -1, -2, ...), copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200). Lengths in mm.

tools.name: split_floors_by_beams
tools.description: Split floors along beam edges and add column openings (pyRevit: Cutslabbybeam). Recreates planar floor regions; not a solid cut. Handles floors with openings, curved beams and real column footprints; slabs that cannot be rebuilt exactly are skipped and counted. Copies instance parameters (Mark, Comments, offsets) onto new pieces. Params: floorIds[], beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; beams/columns fall back to bbox hits), dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean (suffix new Marks -1, -2, ...), copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200). Lengths in mm.
